summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing (1920x800, preview URL) of popup UX polish + featured badge selection. POPUP: all 3 requirements PASS (fresh session popup after ~700ms, Escape closes it, document.body.style.overflow='hidden' while open and restored to '' after close with scrolling verified working, sessionStorage tm2_popup_seen='1' set on first display, popup does NOT reappear after reload in same session). FEATURED BADGES (verified by navigating to tab 3 via the tab header, because the 'Devam' button is broken - see CRITICAL below): 8 pick buttons render for the 8 enabled system features; clicking toggles 'on' class and ★/☆ correctly; selecting a 5th shows toast 'Kartta en fazla 4 rozet gösterilir.' and the 5th stays unselected (count stays 4); setting 'Lonca Ajan Sistemi' to '❌ Yok' removes featured-pick-loncaAjan from the picker (8→7 buttons) and drops it from the selection (on count 1→0), re-enabling brings it back unselected; publishing with exactly 3 picks (bossTakip, guvenliPc, ticaretCami) produced server id 312 whose home card data-testid='server-sys-badges-312' shows EXACTLY '✦ Boss Takip Sistemi ✦ Güvenli PC Girişi ✦ Ticaret Camı +5' (not the default first-4). FALLBACK: seed server Elora2 (server-sys-badges-311) still shows 4 default enabled badges + '+3'. CRITICAL BLOCKER: clicking 'Devam' on tab 2 (Genel Özellikler -> Sistem Özellikleri) immediately SUBMITS the form and publishes the server ('Serveriniz eklendi!' toast fires instantly, redirect to /server/<id> 700ms later) — so via normal UI navigation the user can never use the badge picker at all.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'Devam' on tab 2 (going to tab 3 'Sistem Özellikleri') instantly submits the form and publishes the server (toast 'Serveriniz eklendi! Yönlendiriliyorsunuz...' immediately, navigation to /server/<id> after 700ms). Reproduced 6/6 times, both with real mouse click and after any subsequent interaction. Root cause: React reuses the SAME <button> DOM node for the conditional 'Devam' (type=button) / 'Serveri Yayınla' (type=submit) in the nav slot; during the click the node's type mutates to 'submit' before the browser executes the click's default action, causing implicit form submission. Verified via DOM: after Devam#2 the nav slot contains a focused <button type="submit">Serveri Yayınla</button> that is the same node that was clicked. Fix: give the two buttons distinct keys (key="next" / key="publish") or render the publish button as type="button" with onClick={submit}.

Selecting a 5th badge fires the 'Kartta en fazla 4 rozet gösterilir.' toast TWICE (side effect toast.error() is called inside the setForm updater function, which React StrictMode double-invokes). Move the toast out of the state updater.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix AddServer 'Devam' button on tab 2 submitting/publishing the form (React DOM node reuse switching type=button -> type=submit). Add distinct key props or make publish button type='button' with onClick={submit}.
LOW: Move toast.error('Kartta en fazla 4 rozet gösterilir.') out of the setForm updater to avoid duplicate toasts under StrictMode.
critical_code_review_comments: AddServer.jsx L190-198: conditional Devam/Serveri Yayınla buttons share the same DOM position with no key -> node reuse causes accidental submit. This is the blocker.
AddServer.jsx L45-49: toggleFeatured calls toast.error inside the state updater (impure updater, double-fires in StrictMode).

AddServer.jsx labels/select fields have no data-testid; tests had to rely on '.card-body select' index order. Adding data-testid to the system selects (e.g. sys-select-<key>) would make this robustly testable.

ServerRow.jsx L18: extraSys = enabledSys.length - shownSys.length — with featured badges selected, the '+N' chip counts unshown enabled features (new server shows '+5'); acceptable but slightly confusing when the user explicitly chose fewer badges.

success_rate.frontend: PopupAd 100% (3/3); Featured badges 100% of logic when tab 3 is reached via tab header, but 0% via the intended 'Devam' flow (blocked)

seed_data_creation: Created throwaway servers in browser-local localStorage during runs (TestFeatured, TestFeatured2-6, TestNav, TestNavBug, ids reused as 312 since each Playwright run starts a fresh profile). No shared/persistent data affected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Popup Escape + scroll-lock + once-per-session all verified PASS. Featured badge picker logic (toggle, max-4 toast, disable-removes-pick, publish -> only selected badges on card, seed fallback 4 badges) all verified PASS but ONLY by reaching tab 3 via clicking the tab header ('.tab-btn' has_text 'Sistem Özellikleri'), because clicking 'Devam' on tab 2 publishes the server prematurely. After the main agent fixes the Devam button, re-run the exact same flow using 'Devam' twice from tab 1 and confirm no premature submit. Note: label-based locators like .field:has(label:text-is("Lonca Ajan Sistemi Var Mı ?")) do NOT match (visual-editor wraps label text in spans); use '.card-body select' nth index (order = kEnvanter, bossTakip, guvenliPc, loncaAjan, ticaretCami, yardimciSaman, cevrimdisiPazar, itemKilitleme).
rca_of_the_issue: AddServer nav slot renders either <button type="button">Devam</button> or <button type="submit">Serveri Yayınla</button> at the same JSX position without a key. When 'Devam' is clicked on tab 2, setTab('sistem') runs synchronously (discrete event) and React patches the existing DOM button's type attribute to 'submit'. The browser then runs the default action for the in-flight click on that same node, which is now a submit button, so the form submits: submit() -> addServer() -> toast + setTimeout(navigate, 700). This is why the publish appears to be triggered by the next click the user makes (badge pick / select), and why no explicit submit/requestSubmit call is visible in JS instrumentation.
